Web Development

Online shop made in Prestashop 1.7 for second hand tires, tractor tires and industrial equipment. Products cannot be added to a cart; instead each product has a phone button and an email button. The request form was built by editing TPL, HTML and CSS, using Contact Form 7 from a WordPress page and a JavaScript script. The shop uses Prestashop Addons modules such as JoliSearch and Amazing Gallery, some bought and some adapted for the site.
